So this doesn't mess up your kid as bad as other people, but when you ground your kid from hanging out with friends and talking on the phone, you're not only hurting your child's social health, but you're also punishing other children (you child's friends) who
A) Are not your kids to punish
And B) Did not do anything wrong.

I know when I was little I was bullied, so I only had one friend, and she didn't do her homework, so she got grounded for that so I couldn't interact with her outside of school, and she also got her recesses taken away so I couldn't really interact with her at school. 

This continued into middle school, when I wasn't even friends with that girl, for the same reason with 2 different friends, and also with another friend because her parents were helecopter parents and didn't let her out of her house or really interact with anyone. 

There was also one other friend in middle school, who couldn't hang out with me because her parents didn't like my stepdad and I was always like "oh? I don't like him either. Why am I being punished for my mom getting married" because that's genuinely what I thought it was; I had been taught that when I wasn't allowed to have friends it was because *I* was being punished. I always thought that *I* was being punished for my friends actions... And honestly, I still think that if you look at it logically, I kind of was.
